construction_rule: Only actual final and explicitly cited current-session tool facts/artifact. Missing claims stay missing or null. No oracle/qualification values may be used to construct answers.
contradictions: List unretracted contradictory final declarations with exact quotes. Nonempty fails final quality. Earlier same-turn retracted errors are retained in trace separately.

extra_tool_classification.rubric: Classify actual source-quoted request code/data use. execute_python alone does not mean native correction. Parsing last_observation_json/table indexing/artifact formatting is direct. Whole raw geometry/visibility/pixel recomputation or new native raster is supplemental. Unknown provenance leaves adoption unmeasured. Legitimate repeated same-source active observation is allowed; cached product queries remain direct. Qualification itself remains exactly one active call.
extra_tool_classification.scope: Classification does not replace final quality. A correct supplemented answer can pass quality and fail direct-only adoption.

finite_scope: Actual final must restrict its conclusion to registered finite cameras. Do not convert finite unknown to universal impossibility.
remaining: Explicit claimed remaining/unknown identity list with source-backed reasons; empty must be supported by the actual full-coverage declaration/tool facts, never oracle fill.

source_row.final_reference_excerpt: Literal actual final sentence referencing this tool facts/artifact. Root independently confirms artifact name/path matches. Tool-request sources are infrastructure-only adoption evidence and cannot support answer claims.
source_row.scope: All files must be inside this formal/P1. Source excerpts are literal substrings of raw UTF8 or the decoded actual tool-content text. Use actual line endings.

surface_row.identity: Current roi_id and/or public object_name. If multiple fields are used they must identify the same current source surface. Never insert private oracle labels.
surface_row.pixel_xy: Optional [x,y]; if stated, must be an actual target-owned pixel.
surface_row.support: Nonempty source_id/excerpt list quoting actual current facts/artifact.

target.index: Actual claimed current public pixel index, not an oracle-generated value. Missing/null fails.
target.index_describes_product_witness_separate: Optional true only if source quotes explicitly distinguish the named product index/frame from an additional native witness. Otherwise index and selected view/ref must match.
target.pixel_xy: Mandatory actual target-owned [x,y] inside selected complete view. Other surfaces may omit a pixel coordinate.
target.selected_witness: An actual complete-and-readable current view/ref and its actual counts. A readable partial row is invalid.

unsupported: Preserve actual source remainder. Empty may be quoted from full-support scope facts; do not infer empty from truth.
